confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and draft-beer anchors use current Plovdiv city price data. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from local beer pricing because standardized city averages are sparse. Lodging anchors are holistic estimates without checking live accommodation listings and are least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable-city prices used; food anchors use Plovdiv city-level prices, while lodging is estimated for a lower-cost Bulgarian regional city.
